verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples, such as an in-browser 'try it' console or API playground. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms-full.txt excerpt only shows text endpoint documentation (/stored-actions). The SDK CLI's 'explore and run actions' is a terminal tool for running app actions, not an interactive API reference, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
